summary.name: TXYZ
summary.one_liner: TXYZ is an AI research assistant for reading, searching and managing academic papers, with a writing agent and API access.
use_cases: Discovering academic papers matching research interests
Reading and analysing uploaded research PDFs
Getting up to speed on a new domain
Integrating paper-analysis AI into company or lab tools via API
summary.what_it_does: TXYZ is an AI assistant for research reading and discovery. It gives access to millions of academic papers across disciplines and lets users discover papers that match their interests. Users can upload their own papers for file upload and analysis (up to 100 pages on Pro and Free, up to 300 on Ultra) and keep a personal library, with uploaded papers kept private. It includes writing agents and "Pages" for writing work, with history retention limits by tier. The page says answers include a document location reference to help check accuracy, and API access is offered on request via email.
notable: Access to millions of academic papers across disciplines, with an uploadable personal library
Writing agents and Pages for drafting, with 5 Pages on the free tier
API access for companies, research labs and educational institutions (contact by email)
Answers include document location references to support checking
caveats: Paid Pro and Ultra tiers (billed yearly or monthly) unlock higher limits, longer uploads, and full Library and Pages access
API access requires contacting support@txyz.ai; no public details given
Free tier limited to 100-page uploads, 5 writing Pages and 30-day Pages history
